title: Chapter 7 – Jñāna-Vijñāna Yoga (The Yoga of Knowledge and Wisdom)
subtitle: Yoga of Knowledge and Wisdom

verses.title: 7.1 mayyasakta-manah partha
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः ।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥ ७-१॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ
asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu 7-1
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
mayy aasakta manaah paartha yogam yunjan mad aashrayah
asamshayam samagram maam yathaa jnaasyasi tac chrinu 7-1
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: Listen, Partha, to how you will come to know Me completely and beyond doubt, with your mind fixed on Me, practising YOGA, and taking shelter in Me.

verses.title: 7.2 jnanam te ham
verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ॥ ७-२॥
verses.roman:
jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ
yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate 7-2
verses.colloquial:
jnaanam te'ham sa vijnaanam idam vakshyaami asheshatah
yaj jnaatvaa na iha bhuuyah anyat jnaatavyam avashishyate 7-2
verses.translation_reworded: I will explain to you in full this knowledge together with direct realisation. Once it is known, nothing further remains here to be known.

verses.title: 7.3 manushyanam sahasreshu
verses.sanskrit:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये ।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ॥ ७-३॥
verses.roman:
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye
yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ 7-3
verses.colloquial:
manushyaanaam sahasreshu kashchid yatati siddhaye
yatataam api siddhaanaam kashchin maam vetti tattvatah 7-3
verses.translation_reworded: Out of thousands of people, perhaps one strives for perfection. And even among those who strive and succeed, perhaps only one knows Me as I truly am.

verses.title: 7.4 bhumir-apo nalo vayuh
verses.sanskrit:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा ॥ ७-४॥
verses.roman:
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca
ahaṅkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā 7-4
verses.colloquial:
bhuumih aapah analah vaayuh kham manah buddhih eva cha
ahankaarah iti iyam me bhinnaa prakritih ashtadhaa 7-4
verses.translation_reworded: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and egoism: these make up My eightfold PRAKRITI.

verses.title: 7.5 apareyam itas tvanyam
verses.sanskrit:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् ।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥ ७-५॥
verses.roman:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām
jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat 7-5
verses.colloquial:
apareyam itas tv anyaam prakritim viddhi me paraam
jiiva bhuutaam mahaa baaho yayedam dhaaryate jagat 7-5
verses.translation_reworded: That is the lower PRAKRITI. O mighty-armed one, know that My Higher PRAKRITI is different from it. It is the very Life-element that holds this world up.

verses.title: 7.6 etad-yonini bhutani
verses.sanskrit:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय ।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ॥ ७-६॥
verses.roman:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya
ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā 7-6
verses.colloquial:
etad yoniini bhuutaani sarvaaniiti upadhaaraya
aham kritsnasya jagatah prabhavah pralayah tathaa 7-6
verses.translation_reworded: Understand that these (two PRAKRITIS) are the womb from which all beings come. So I am the origin of the whole universe and also where it dissolves.

verses.title: 7.7 mattah parataram nanyat
verses.sanskrit:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय ।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥ ७-७॥
verses.roman:
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva 7-7
verses.colloquial:
mattah parataram naanyat kinchid asti dhananjaya
mayi sarvam idam protam suutre maniganaa iva 7-7
verses.translation_reworded: O Dhananjaya, there is nothing at all higher than Me. Everything here is threaded on Me, like clusters of gems on a string.

verses.title: 7.8 raso ham apsu kaunteya
verses.sanskrit:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥ ७-८॥
verses.roman:
raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu 7-8
verses.colloquial:
raso'ham apsu kaunteya prabhaasmi shashisuuryayoh
pranavah sarva vedeshu shabdah khe paurusham nrishu 7-8
verses.translation_reworded: O son of Kunti, I am the taste in water. I am the light in the moon and the sun. I am the syllable OM in all the VEDAS, the sound in ether, and the manliness in men.

verses.title: 7.9 punyo gandhah prithivyam
verses.sanskrit:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ॥ ७-९॥
verses.roman:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu 7-9
verses.colloquial:
punyo gandhah prithivyaam cha tejash chaasmi vibhaavasau
jiivanam sarva bhuuteshu tapash chaasmi tapasvishu 7-9
verses.translation_reworded: I am the pleasant fragrance in earth and the brightness in fire. I am the life in every being, and I am the austerity in those who practise austerity.

verses.title: 7.10 bijam mam sarva-bhutanam
verses.sanskrit:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥ ७-१०॥
verses.roman:
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham 7-10
verses.colloquial:
biijam maam sarva bhuutaanaam viddhi paartha sanaatanam
buddhih buddhimataam asmi tejah tejasvinaam aham 7-10
verses.translation_reworded: O Partha, know Me as the everlasting seed of all beings. I am the intelligence of the intelligent, and I am the splendour of all splendid (things and beings).

verses.title: 7.11 balam balavatam chaham
verses.sanskrit:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् ।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ॥ ७-११॥
verses.roman:
balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣabha 7-11
verses.colloquial:
balam balavataam chaaham kaama raaga vivarjitam
dharmaaviruddho bhuuteshu kaamo'smi bharata rishabha 7-11
verses.translation_reworded: O best of the Bharatas, I am the strength of the strong, a strength free of desire and attachment. And in (all) beings I am the desire that does not conflict with DHARMA.

verses.title: 7.12 ye chaiva sattvika
verses.sanskrit:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥ ७-१२॥
verses.roman:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi 7-12
verses.colloquial:
ye chaiva saattvikaa bhaavaa raajasaas taamasaash cha ye
matta eva iti taan viddhi na tv aham teshu te mayi 7-12
verses.translation_reworded: Whatever beings (and objects) are pure, active, or inert, know that they all come from Me. Yet I am not in them; they are in Me.

verses.title: 7.13 tribhir guna-mayair
verses.sanskrit:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् ॥ ७-१३॥
verses.roman:
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvair ebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat
mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam 7-13
verses.colloquial:
tribhir gunamayair bhaavair ebhih sarvam idam jagat
mohitam na abhijaanaati maam ebhyah parama avyayam 7-13
verses.translation_reworded: Confused by these natures (states or things) made of the three GUNAS (of PRAKRITI), the whole world fails to recognise Me as the Unchanging One, distinct from them.

verses.title: 7.14 daivi hyesha guna-mayi
verses.sanskrit:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥ ७-१४॥
verses.roman:
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te 7-14
verses.colloquial:
daivii hyeshaa guna mayii mama maayaa duratyayaa
maam eva ye prapadyante maayaam etaam taranti te 7-14
verses.translation_reworded: This divine illusion of Mine, built from the GUNAS (caused by the qualities), is truly hard to get past. Only those who take shelter in Me get across this illusion.

verses.title: 7.15 na mam dushkritino
verses.sanskrit:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः ॥ ७-१५॥
verses.roman:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ 7-15
verses.colloquial:
na maam dushkritino muudhaah prapadyante naraadhamaah
maayayaa apahrita jnaanaa aasuram bhaavam aashritaah 7-15
verses.translation_reworded: Those who do evil, the deluded, the lowest of men, do not seek Me. Their power of discrimination has been wrecked by their own delusions, and they walk the path of the demons.

verses.title: 7.16 chatur-vidha bhajante
verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन ।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ॥ ७-१६॥
verses.roman:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino'rjuna
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha 7-16
verses.colloquial:
chatur vidhaa bhajante maam janaah sukritino'rjuna
aarto jijnaasuh artha arthii jnaanii cha bharata rishabha 7-16
verses.translation_reworded: O Arjuna, four kinds of virtuous people worship Me: the distressed, the seeker of (systematised) knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the wise, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.title: 7.17 tesham jnani nitya-yukta
verses.sanskrit:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते ।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥ ७-१७॥
verses.roman:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate
priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ 7-17
verses.colloquial:
teshaam jnaanii nitya yukta eka bhaktir vishishyate
priyo hi jnaanino'tyartham aham sa cha mama priyah 7-17
verses.translation_reworded: Among these, the wise person, always steady and devoted to the One, stands highest. For I am very dear to the wise, and the wise person is dear to Me.

verses.title: 7.18 udarah sarva evaite
verses.sanskrit:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥ ७-१८॥
verses.roman:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim 7-18
verses.colloquial:
udaaraah sarva evaite jnaanii tvaatmaiva me matam
aasthitah sa hi yukta aatmaa maam eva anuttamaam gatim 7-18
verses.translation_reworded: All of these are indeed noble, but I consider the wise person to be My very Self. With a steady mind, he is settled in Me alone as the Supreme Goal.

verses.title: 7.19 bahunam janmanam ante
verses.sanskrit:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते ।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ॥ ७-१९॥
verses.roman:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate
vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ 7-19
verses.colloquial:
bahuunaam janmanaam ante jnaanavaan maam prapadyate
vaasudevah sarvam iti sa mahaatmaa su durlabhah 7-19
verses.translation_reworded: After many births, the wise person comes to Me, realising that all this is Vasudeva (the innermost Self). Such a great soul (MAHATMA) is very rare.

verses.title: 7.20 kamais tais tair
verses.sanskrit:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥ ७-२०॥
verses.roman:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā 7-20
verses.colloquial:
kaamaih taistair hrita jnaanaah prapadyante 'nya devataah
tam tam niyamam aasthaaya prakrityaa niyataah svayaa 7-20
verses.translation_reworded: Those whose wisdom has been carried off by one desire or another turn to other gods and follow one rite or another, driven by their own nature.

verses.title: 7.21 yo yo yam yam
verses.sanskrit:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ॥ ७-२१॥
verses.roman:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati
tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham 7-21
verses.colloquial:
yo yo yaam yaam tanum bhaktah shraddhayaa architum icchati
tasya tasya achalaam shraddhaam taam eva vidadhaami aham 7-21
verses.translation_reworded: Whatever form a devotee wishes to worship with faith, I make that faith of his (firm and) unwavering.

verses.title: 7.22 sa taya shraddhaya
verses.sanskrit:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ॥ ७-२२॥
verses.roman:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitānhi tān 7-22
verses.colloquial:
sa tayaa shraddhayaa yuktah tasyaaraadhanam iihate
labhate cha tatah kaamaan mayaiva vihitaan hi taan 7-22
verses.translation_reworded: Equipped with that faith, he worships that DEVATA and gains from it the fulfilment of his wishes. All of this, in truth, is arranged by Me (alone).

verses.title: 7.23 antavat tu phalam
verses.sanskrit:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ॥ ७-२३॥
verses.roman:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām
devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi 7-23
verses.colloquial:
antavat tu phalam teshaam tadbhavati alpa medhasaam
devaan devayajo yaanti madbhaktaa yaanti maam api 7-23
verses.translation_reworded: But the reward that comes to those people of limited understanding is finite. Those who worship the DEVAS go to the DEVAS; My devotees come to Me.

verses.title: 7.24 avyaktam vyaktim
verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः ।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ॥ ७-२४॥
verses.roman:
avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam 7-24
verses.colloquial:
avyaktam vyakti maapannam manyante maam abuddhayah
param bhaavam ajaananto mama avyaya manuttamam 7-24
verses.translation_reworded: The unwise imagine that I, the Unmanifest, have taken on manifestation. They do not know My higher nature, which is unchanging and without equal.

verses.title: 7.25 naham prakashah sarvasya
verses.sanskrit:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः ।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् ॥ ७-२५॥
verses.roman:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ
mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam 7-25
verses.colloquial:
naaham prakaashah sarvasya yogamaayaa samaavritah
muudho'yam naabhijaanaati loko maam ajam avyayam 7-25
verses.translation_reworded: Hidden by Divine MAYA, I am not revealed to everyone (in My Real Nature). This deluded world does not know Me, the Unborn and Imperishable.

verses.title: 7.26 vedaham samatitani
verses.sanskrit:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन ।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥ ७-२६॥
verses.roman:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana 7-26
verses.colloquial:
vedaaham samatiitaani vartamaanaani chaarjuna
bhavishyaani cha bhuutaani maam tu veda na kashchana 7-26
verses.translation_reworded: O Arjuna, I know the beings of the past, the present, and the future, but no one knows Me.

verses.title: 7.27 ichchha-dvesha-samutthena
verses.sanskrit:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत ।
सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ॥ ७-२७॥
verses.roman:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata
sarvabhūtāni sammohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa 7-27
verses.colloquial:
icchaa dvesha samutthena dvandva mohena bhaarata
sarva bhuutaani sammoham sarge yaanti parantapa 7-27
verses.translation_reworded: O Bharata, O Parantapa (scorcher of foes), from the moment of birth all beings fall under delusion, caused by the pairs of opposites that spring from desire and aversion.

verses.title: 7.28 yesham tvanta-gatam
verses.sanskrit:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ॥ ७-२८॥
verses.roman:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ 7-28
verses.colloquial:
yeshaam tvantagatam paapam janaanaam punya karmanaam
te dvandva moha nirmuktaa bhajante maam dridha vrataah 7-28
verses.translation_reworded: But those people of virtuous deeds whose sins have come to an end, who are free from the delusion of the pairs of opposites and firm in their vows, worship Me.

verses.title: 7.29 jara-marana-mokshaya
verses.sanskrit:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये ।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥ ७-२९॥
verses.roman:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam 7-29
verses.colloquial:
jaraa marana mokshaaya maam aashritya yatanti ye
te brahma tad viduh kritsnam adhyaatmam karma cha akhilam 7-29
verses.translation_reworded: Those who take shelter in Me and strive for freedom from old age and death come to know fully that BRAHMAN, the whole knowledge of the Self, and all action.

verses.title: 7.30 sadhibhutadhidaivam
verses.sanskrit:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥ ७-३०॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
ज्ञानविज्ञानयोगो नाम सप्तमोऽध्यायः ॥ ७॥
verses.roman:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ
prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ 7-30

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
jñānavijñānayogo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ 7
verses.colloquial:
saadhibhuuta adhidaivam maam saadhiyajnam cha ye viduh
prayaana kaale'pi cha maam te viduh yukta chetasah

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaa suupanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
jnaana vijnaana yogo naama saptamo'dhyaayah 7
verses.translation_reworded:
Those who know Me along with the ADHIBHUTA (pertaining to the elements; the world of objects), the ADHIDAIVA (pertaining to the gods; the sense-organs), and the ADHIYAJNA (pertaining to the sacrifice; all perceptions), know Me even at the moment of death, with a steady mind.

Thus, in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna, ends the seventh discourse, entitled "The Yoga of Knowledge and Wisdom."
